name: @fitness-ai-app/creator-portal
description: Creator Portal (R2 Wave 5, 21 Sep 2026) — an Influencer's own self-service login + dashboard: their own real Campaign(s)/link code(s), a per-campaign attribution report scoped to just those campaigns, and their own InfluencerPayout history. Copies apps/admin-web's exact Vite/React/TS stack and AuthProvider/RequireAuth pattern, keyed to the separate `Influencer` identity instead of AdminUser — see apps/api's influencerAuth + influencerPortal modules for the real backend.
